# Cayman Islands Massage by Tranquilitas

Luxury mobile massage service focused on Grand Cayman.

Canonical site: https://cayman.tranquilitasspa.com/

Primary services: Swedish Massage, Deep Tissue Massage, Couples Massage, Villa Massage, Hotel / Resort Massage, Yacht Massage and Mobile Massage.

No beach massage is offered in the Cayman Islands.

Current Cayman pricing verified from Tranquilitas Setmore on October 4, 2026:
Swedish $145 for 60 min / $185 for 90 min.
Deep Tissue $165 / $220.
Couples $290 / $395.

Primary Grand Cayman service areas include Seven Mile Beach, West Bay, Camana Bay, George Town, South Sound, Bodden Town, Rum Point, Cayman Kai and East End, subject to therapist availability and property access.

Booking requests remain pending until therapist availability and access are confirmed.
